content:
16GFC and 8GFC are not FEC modes (Table 2 note b), so `fec_type` belongs only on 32GFC. Revised JSON:

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "32GFC 28.05 Gb/s",
      "form_factor": "SFP28",
      "host_interface_name": "3200-M5-SN-S",
      "media_interface_name": "3200-M5-SN-S",
      "frame": "64B/66B",
      "standards_code": "32GFC",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 28.05,
      "modulation_format": "LINECODE_64B66B",
      "reach_km": 0.02,
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -6.2,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 2.0,
      "fec_type": "RS_528_514"
    },
    {
      "label": "16GFC 14.025 Gb/s",
      "form_factor": "SFP28",
      "host_interface_name": "1600-M5-SN-S",
      "media_interface_name": "1600-M5-SN-S",
      "frame": "64B/66B",
      "standards_code": "16GFC",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 14.025,
      "modulation_format": "LINECODE_64B66B",
      "reach_km": 0.035,
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -7.8,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 0.0
    },
    {
      "label": "8GFC 8.5 Gb/s",
      "form_factor": "SFP28",
      "host_interface_name": "800-M5-SN-S",
      "media_interface_name": "800-M5-SN-S",
      "frame": "8B/10B",
      "standards_code": "8GFC",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 8.5,
      "modulation_format": "LINECODE_8B10B",
      "reach_km": 0.05,
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -8.2,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 0.0
    }
  ]
}
```

If every mode must include `fec_type`, say so and we can align with your validator (e.g. duplicate keys vs. placeholder).
